input_payload: According to the report, gain on completion of Consumer Healthcare JV transaction for Pfizer Inc. in FY2019 was $-8107M. According to the report, other income/deductions, net for Pfizer Inc. in FY2019 was $3497M. According to the report, income from continuing operations for Pfizer Inc. in FY2019 was $10738M. According to the report, discontinued operations, net of tax for Pfizer Inc. in FY2019 was $5318M. According to the report, net income before allocation to noncontrolling interests for Pfizer Inc. in FY2019 was $16056M. According to the report, net income attributable to Pfizer Inc. common shareholders for Pfizer Inc. in FY2019 was $16026M.
handoff_payload:
Yes. Pfizer’s 2019 net income was substantially affected by items outside its standard operations:

- The completion of the Consumer Healthcare joint-venture transaction was associated with a reported gain of $8,107 million (shown in the input as -$8,107 million).
- Discontinued operations contributed $5,318 million after tax.
- Other income, net, contributed $3,497 million.

These items helped produce net income of $16,056 million before noncontrolling interests, including $10,738 million from continuing operations.
